title: Store parser: first store
lead: Define the StoreParser plugin protocol and implement the parser for the deployment's primary store (O2).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** item matching (separate slice); additional stores.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The primary store carries most of the pantry value, and the first parser sets the plugin pattern for every other store.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Which store is first (from the receipts interview's field inventory)?
2. Which email is authoritative: the order confirmation, or the "ready/picked up" email that reflects substitutions? (from samples)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Define the `StoreParser` protocol: `matches(msg)`, `parse(msg) -> Order`, and register parsers by config.
2. Extract the HTML part with `email`; parse it with `html.parser` (stdlib) into rows.
3. Normalize the item name, quantity and size.
4. Log parse failures to an admin-visible list.
5. Document how to add a store parser (for other deployments).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Tests pass on all redacted samples for the store.
- The docs include a "writing a store parser" section.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
